_comment: Bannerlord Coop dedicated server. The image ships no game files: on boot it reads a release manifest.json from the Bannerlord Coop GitHub releases, verifies the Windows dedicated server archive against its SHA-256 and extracts it into the server volume. No Steam account or Steam Guard prompt is needed. Allocate two consecutive UDP ports: clients join on the primary and the mod also uses primary+1.
name: Bannerlord Coop
author: geoffrey.migliacci@gmail.com
description: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord cooperative campaign server, running the Windows dedicated server build under Wine. The build is downloaded from the Bannerlord Coop GitHub releases on first start. Saves, configs and dated backups live in the server volume.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The game files are downloaded by the container at boot, not here: the
# dedicated server build comes from the Bannerlord Coop GitHub releases.
# This only lays out the directories start.sh expects.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/game /mnt/server/data/mods
echo "Directories ready."
echo "On first start the server downloads the Windows dedicated server build"
echo "(about 4.2 GB) from the Bannerlord Coop GitHub releases. No Steam account"
echo "is needed."

variables.name: Coop release
variables.description: GitHub release tag to install, for example v0.1.6. latest follows the newest stable Bannerlord Coop release. Releases older than v0.1.6 do not publish manifest.json and cannot be installed this way.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Check the Bannerlord Coop GitHub releases for a newer dedicated server build on every start. 0 skips GitHub and uses the files already present.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: World to host, from Game Saves in the data directory. A missing save is created from default_new_game.sav.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Password joining players are prompted for. Empty means open.

variables.name: Autosave minutes
variables.description: Minutes between world autosaves. 0 disables autosaving.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Where saves, configs, logs, backups and the mods folder live. Internal.

variables.name: Game directory
variables.description: Where the dedicated server release is extracted. Must persist. Internal.

variables.name: Wine prefix
variables.description: Created on first boot inside the volume, since the container does not run as root. Internal.
